reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that discovers MCP server definitions from supported tool configuration files, merges them by precedence, and keeps the mounted server set synchronized with those files.

summaries.zh: 从 Claude Code、Kiro、OpenCode、Codex 及 Harness 配置文件中发现并合并 MCP 服务器，并将其同步挂载到 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Discovers and merges MCP server definitions from Claude Code, Kiro, OpenCode, Codex, and Harness configuration files, then synchronizes the mounted servers in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads MCP configuration files from supported user and project paths
Parses JSON, JSONC, and TOML MCP configuration formats
Merges server definitions across configuration layers
Mounts, updates, and unmounts MCP servers in the DeepSeek Harness
Watches configuration files and reloads affected server entries
Optionally writes imported MCP entries to the harness configuration when explicitly invoked
